comment: Atlas fogs: a swirling-fog screen effect (ScreenEffect.dbc type 3, drawn over the scene, so a dungeon's own
WMO fog can't hide it) carried by an aura-260 spell, both in patch-T.MPQ; the spell also goes to spell_dbc.
colour is ARGB (alpha = density), spread 1-255 (how far the swirl reaches; Mist of the Kvaldir 6), strength
0-100 (% blended over the scene; Kvaldir 40). Reserved IDs: spells 90400-90449, ScreenEffect 900-949.
'use' picks the fog like atlas_atmosphere picks the sky: theme at a corruption level (255 = any level),
theme 0 = any theme, or an affix (an affix fog wins over the theme's). Only accounts with the Atlas patch
(.atlas clones on) get the aura; it drops on leaving the map or logging out.
